title: Attacks 29 and 45: on /embed/<id> links drawn inside a tool keep the browser's default link colour (#0000EE), 1.99 to 1 on the dark page
location: site/src/pages/embed/[tool].astro:16 imports only base.css, not the global rules of site/src/layouts/Base.astro:91-97 (a { color: var(--text) }; a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible ring). claim: The link colour and the focus ring of links and buttons are set only by Base.astro's global style. The embed route does not use that layout, so every link a tool draws is #0000EE (visited #551A8B) in both themes, below A-6 in the dark theme. Buttons without their own :focus-visible rule fall back to the browser ring there.
expected: SPEC 7.5 A-6: text at least 4.5 to 1 in light and dark themes; 7.4: /embed/<tool> renders the tool alone, with the same tool as /tools/<tool> (whose links are drawn in var(--text), 15.3 to 1 on #121212).

A-11: what cannot reflow scrolls inside its own box, and that box is keyboard-operable (A-1, WCAG 2.1.1). 7.7: no serious axe violation. The frozen boards themselves stay focusable with aria-disabled (Board.svelte header), and the table view should follow the same rule.

'RT-FIX-P4-...: .tool-frame minmax(0, 1fr)' made the table scroll inside .bare and says nothing on focus. Round1 P3-RT-05-04 (major, confirmed) read A-11 and A-1 the same way.
